items.title: Day 8, Not Day 10 🐌 Riddle #12 Answer + Riddle #13: Two Ropes, Exactly 45 Minutes 🔥 #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday, a snail in a 10 meter well, up 3 meters every day and down 2 meters every night.  So each full day and night, the snail only gains 1 meter.  After 7 days and 7 nights, it is at 7 meters.  On day 8, it climbs 3 more meters and reaches the top.  It is out on day 8, not day 10.  Now a brand new mystery.  Person 1 has 2 ropes and a lighter.  Each rope takes exactly 1 hour to burn.  But they burn unevenly, fast in some parts and slow in others.  There is no clock, no phone and no ruler.  How can person 1 measure exactly 45 minutes?  Comment your answer.  The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.
qa.second_check_notes: Fresh-subagent review: #12 answer (day 8) correct; #13 two ropes / 45 min well-posed, answer not shown in video or description; no salam, Person 1 only, back view; no faith symbols. After the review the rope-burn card was re-timed (linear burn) and re-rendered; re-checked by qa_check.

items.title: Roz Subah Do Farishton Ki Dua! Aap Kis Mein Hain? | Sahih Bukhari 1442 #shorts

qa.heard: روز سبہ آسمان سے دو فرشت اترتے ہیں اور جانتے ہیں وہ کیا دعا کرتے ہیں؟  حضرت ابو حررا رزی اللہانہو بیان کرتے ہیں یہ حمارِ نبی محمد مصطفہ صل اللہ تعالی علی ہی وعالی ہی وصل نے فرمایا  اور سبہ دو فرشت اترتے ہیں ایک فرشتہ کہتا ہے اے اللہ خرج کرنے والے کو اس کا بدلہ اتا فرما  اور دوسرا کہتا ہے اے اللہ روک کر رکھنے والے کا مال برباد کر دے  تو آج آپ کس دعا میں شامل ہوں گے چاہے دس روپے ہوں  آج کچھ دے دیں کمنٹ میں لکھیں آج میں نے صدقہ دیا یہ ویڈیو آگے بھیجیں یہ بھی ایک اور صدقہ ہے

items.label: kids
items.title: Grrr! Someone Took My Toy! 🧸 Don't Get Angry | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.heard: Grr, your brother took your toy and you feel so angry. What do you do?  A man once asked,  Please give me some advice.  And the answer was do not get angry. The man asked again and again and every time the answer was do not get angry.  So when you feel angry, stop and take a deep breath.  After that use kind words. Can I have my toy back please?  The man saying calm is what a strong Muslim does.  Now can you stay calm today? Say yes I can.
